foreshadowing_elements.description: Deceased mother's jade pendant that protagonist always wears

hints.hint: Pendant feels warm during protagonist's first Qi circulation
Elder glances at pendant with shocked expression, says nothing
Pendant glows faintly when protagonist faces death

foreshadowing_elements.resolution: Pendant contains soul fragment of ancient immortal empress, protagonist's true ancestor. Awakens to save protagonist and offer inheritance.
foreshadowing_elements.notes: Planted early enough readers forget, payoff references all three hints

foreshadowing_elements.description: Cultivation technique scroll protagonist can't read yet

hints.hint: Techniques seems to be in ancient language, protagonist shelves it for later
After breakthrough, protagonist checks scroll again. Still can't read it, needs higher cultivation

foreshadowing_elements.resolution: Planned: Supreme technique that only reveals itself to Golden Core cultivators

planting: Bury important foreshadowing in scenes with other purposes
Use rule of three: hint at least 3 times before payoff
Vary subtlety: first hint barely noticeable, last hint obvious
Space hints far apart so readers forget early ones
payoff: Make payoff bigger than setup implied
Reference multiple planted elements simultaneously for epic moments
tracking: Log every foreshadowing element immediately when planted
Review tracker before writing each chapter
Mark elements as 'due soon' when approaching payoff chapter
Note reader expectations based on hints given
